description: Rb₂NaNdBr₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Br atoms to form RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NdBr₆ octahedra. All Rb-Br bond lengths are 4.09 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NdBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-Br bond lengths are 2.88 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Nd atom.
